think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values in PostgreSQL. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with a natural ordering and whether it has sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that trigger a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior). 3) Determine if any such sentinel value exists for this knob. 4) Classify as 'special knob' only if it is numeric and has such special sentinel values; otherwise classify as not special.
